svg.title: Barge
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Near-black field has straight top and sides, with rounded lower corners on a narrow white rectangular painted ground. Frame and glazing are excluded. Approximate border thickness and corner curvature. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-paris-new-york-1949-1959/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek78-ellsworth-kelly-paris-new-york-1949-1959; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
